attributes.name: Druva - Backup Policy Modified by Rare Actor
attributes.description: Detects backup-policy modifications from administrators rarely observed making such changes.
author: Druva
tags: Druva Detection Pack 0 – Core Cyber Resilience

meta.pack: Druva Detection Pack 0 – Core Cyber Resilience
meta.customer_usecase: Detects backup-policy modifications from administrators rarely observed making such changes.

attributes.query:
FROM logs-druva.event-*
| EVAL actor = COALESCE(
    TO_STRING(user.name),
    TO_STRING(user.id),
    TO_STRING(user.email)
  )

| EVAL policy = COALESCE(
    TO_STRING(druva.profile.name),
    TO_STRING(druva.resource.name)
  )

| EVAL event_text = TO_LOWER(
    COALESCE(
      TO_STRING(message),
      TO_STRING(message),
      TO_STRING(druva.event_type),
      ""
    )
  )

| EVAL event_time =
    @timestamp

| WHERE actor IS NOT NULL
    AND (
      event_text LIKE "*backup*policy*modif*"
      OR event_text LIKE "*backup*policy*updat*"
      OR event_text LIKE "*retention*policy*"
      OR event_text LIKE "*backup profile*updat*"
    )

| STATS
    modification_count =
      COUNT(*),

    policies =
      VALUES(policy),

    event_types =
      VALUES(druva.event_type),

    first_seen =
      MIN(event_time),

    last_seen =
      MAX(event_time),

    latest_policy =
      LAST(policy, event_time),

    latest_action =
      LAST(druva.event_type, event_time),

    latest_details =
      LAST(
        TO_STRING(message),
        event_time
      )

  BY actor

| WHERE modification_count <= 2
